text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending December 31, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.

The Bid Award Panel: 1. Elected the Chief Financial Officer, Finance and Treasury Services Designate as Vice Chair of the Bid Award Panel for a term of office starting January 11, 2023 and ending December 31, 2023, and until a successor is appointed.
